notes.title: Demo Hotfix for Update 3
notes.notes:
Demo Hotfix for Update 3

The game now runs on dedicated GPU's by default (eliminating low fps problems)

This was a small but very important fix. 



For everyone who experienced a low fps problem with Palpus X Annihilation: 

NOW IS YOUR TIME! ;)



-Meister Palpus

notes.title: Demo Update 3: Performance & Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Listen up soldiers!

The demo was updated again to address 

performance and fixing bugs, aswell as gameplay fixes and more!



Changes:

added more contrast to the game overall

improved loading times

improved overall performance due to compilation changes

added detailed shadows to all characters

added sounds to pause menu

added "reload from checkpoint" option

fixed characters not showing up behind transparent trees

Sound changes to barrels and skillmenu

improved item visibility and pickup range

alt-tab now pauses the game

fixed wall glitch

fixed decals and dead bodies skipping positions

numerous small fixes



This is a nice batch of fixes as you can see. 

Hope to see you playing the demo again and...



See you on full release later this year!



-Meister Palpus

notes.title: Demo Update 2: Gameplay & Fixes
notes.notes:
Listen up soldiers!

Another update was pushed to the demo, improving gameplay and overall playability.

Changes:

- Diagonal movement now uses correct acceleration

- Improved camera behaviour

- Reloading an already loaded gun is no longer possible

- Improved grenade UI visibility

- Improved numerous weapon effects

- Added Tooltips

- Rebalanced missions

- Added turret

The game plays a lot smoother now. Enjoy!


Stay tuned for more updates!

Meister Palpus
